mapper.sql: sys_id, plant_cd, owner_user_sys_id, plan_sys_id, amount, currency, period_month, provider, provider_store_id, provider_customer_id, provider_subscription_id, checkout_attempt_id, checkout_expires_at, status, paid_through_at, grace_until, end_at, cancel_requested_at, expired_at, provider_end_status, payment_method_status, role_granted_yn, role_granted_at, role_revoked_at, last_failure_code, insert_user_id
mapper.insert: insert into sys_subscription ( sys_id, plant_cd, owner_user_sys_id, status, provider_end_status, payment_method_status, role_granted_yn, insert_user_id, insert_datetime ) values ( #{sysId}, #{plantCd}, #{ownerUserSysId}, #{status}, 'NONE', 'NONE', 'N', #{insertUserId}, now() )
mapper.select: select from sys_subscription where plant_cd = #{plantCd} and status <> 'EXPIRED'
select from sys_subscription where plant_cd = #{plantCd} and status <> 'EXPIRED' for update
select from sys_subscription where status <> 'EXPIRED' and owner_user_sys_id in #{id} order by sys_id for update
mapper.update: update sys_user u set user_role = '01', modify_user_id = #{userId}, modify_datetime = now() from sys_subscription s where s.sys_id = #{subscriptionSysId} and u.sys_id = s.owner_user_sys_id and u.plant_cd = s.plant_cd and u.plant_cd <> 'ADMIN' and u.user_role = '02' and u.delete_yn = 'N'

update sys_subscription set role_granted_yn = 'Y', role_granted_at = #{now}, role_revoked_at = null, modify_user_id = #{userId}, modify_datetime = now() where sys_id = #{subscriptionSysId} and role_granted_yn = 'N'

update sys_user u set user_role = '02', modify_user_id = #{userId}, modify_datetime = now() from sys_subscription s where s.sys_id = #{subscriptionSysId} and s.role_granted_yn = 'Y' and s.role_revoked_at is null and u.sys_id = s.owner_user_sys_id and u.plant_cd = s.plant_cd and u.user_role = '01'
update sys_subscription set role_revoked_at = #{now}, modify_user_id = #{userId}, modify_datetime = now() where sys_id = #{subscriptionSysId} and role_granted_yn = 'Y' and role_revoked_at is null
